verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a sandbox platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no data-export feature, such as exporting snapshots, volumes, or account data in open formats. SSH access and Dockerfile-defined images are adjacent building blocks or user-side workarounds, and the public GitHub repo concerns source code, not exporting user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
